At Gordon Physical Therapy, we help our clients stay active, mobile, independent and free from medications and surgery. Through our YouTube channel, we're able to offer a variety of free information designed to help you make a good decision about your health. If you have more questions, please feel free to email us directly at info@GordonPhysicalTherapy.com. You can also find more free tips and advice by visit our website at https://www.GordonPhysicalTherapy.com 

Thanks for watching! Don't forget to subscribe :-)
